import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time
from collections import Counter

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/jit-cursor/profile'
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
reference_path = root / 'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json'
reference = json.loads(reference_path.read_text())
bench = (root / '../algorithm-benchmarks').resolve()
compiler = root / 'build/jit-calls/mmay'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def parse(text):
    graph = text.split('Call graph:\n',1)[1].split('Total number in stack',1)[0]
    roots, stack = [], []
    for line in graph.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'^([\s+!:|]*)(\d+) (.+)$', line)
        if not m: continue
        depth, count, label = len(m[1]), int(m[2]), m[3]
        name = label.split('  (in ',1)[0]
        node = {'depth':depth,'count':count,'name':name,'children':[]}
        while stack and stack[-1]['depth'] >= depth: stack.pop()
        if stack: stack[-1]['children'].append(node)
        else: roots.append(node)
        stack.append(node)
    inclusive, exclusive = Counter(), Counter()
    def walk(node, ancestors):
        name, count = node['name'], node['count']
        # Inclusive recursion is counted once along each call path.
        if name not in ancestors: inclusive[name] += count
        own = count - sum(child['count'] for child in node['children'])
        assert own >= 0, node
        exclusive[name] += own
        for child in node['children']: walk(child, ancestors | {name})
    for node in roots: walk(node,set())
    total = sum(n['count'] for n in roots)
    assert total > 0 and sum(exclusive.values()) == total
    return {'samples':total, 'inclusive':dict(inclusive.most_common()), 'exclusive':dict(exclusive.most_common())}

def verify():
    for path, digest in reference['metadata']['source_sha256'].items():
        assert sha(bench / path) == digest, path

if __name__ == '__main__':
    verify()
    report = {'schema':'marimay.vm-sampling-profile/1','status':'running',
        'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'compiler_sha256':sha(compiler), 'reference_sha256':sha(reference_path),
        'source_sha256':reference['metadata']['source_sha256'],
        'note':'Diagnostic sampling only, not benchmark timing. Three fresh unchanged runs per workload; sample attaches after process launch and observes up to two seconds at 1 ms intervals. Early startup and the tail may be missed. Inclusive counts overlap; exclusive counts partition sampled stacks. Anonymous frames are not automatically claimed as generated code.',
        'tool':'/usr/bin/sample PID 2 1 -mayDie -file OUTPUT', 'workloads':{}}
    for name in ('bfs','dsu','min-heap'):
        row = reference['workloads'][name]
        command = list(row['commands']['marimay-vm'])
        source = Path('marimay/benchmarks') / name.replace('-','_') if row.get('anchor') else Path('marimay/catalog')
        assert Path(command[2]).as_posix().endswith('/'+source.as_posix())
        command[0], command[2] = str(compiler), str(bench / source)
        runs = []
        for trial in range(3):
            path = base / f'{name}-{trial+1}.txt'
            with (base / f'{name}-{trial+1}.stdout').open('w') as out, (base / f'{name}-{trial+1}.stderr').open('w') as err:
                began = time.perf_counter_ns()
                process = subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=bench,stdout=out,stderr=err)
                sample = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sample',str(process.pid),'2','1','-mayDie','-file',str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
                code = process.wait(timeout=180)
                elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - began) / 1000000
            stdout = (base / f'{name}-{trial+1}.stdout').read_text()
            stderr = (base / f'{name}-{trial+1}.stderr').read_text()
            assert code == 0 and stdout == row['expected_stdout'], (name, code, stdout, stderr)
            assert sample.returncode == 0 and path.exists(), (name, sample.returncode, sample.stdout, sample.stderr)
            runs.append({'command':command,'status':'passed','profile_file':str(path.relative_to(root)),
                'profile_sha256':sha(path),'profiler_stdout':sample.stdout,'profiler_stderr':sample.stderr,
                'process_stdout':stdout,'process_stderr':stderr,'diagnostic_elapsed_ms_including_sampling':elapsed_ms,**parse(path.read_text())})
            print(name, trial+1, runs[-1]['samples'], 'samples', flush=True)
        total = sum(run['samples'] for run in runs)
        inclusive, exclusive = Counter(), Counter()
        for run in runs: inclusive.update(run['inclusive']); exclusive.update(run['exclusive'])
        report['workloads'][name] = {'runs':runs,'samples':total,'inclusive':dict(inclusive.most_common()),'exclusive':dict(exclusive.most_common())}
        (base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    verify()
    assert report['compiler_sha256'] == sha(compiler)
    report['finished_utc'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    report['status']='passed'
    (base / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
